The m182, m202, m95, m118 and m123 groups provide interpretable condition contrasts, while m125, m28, m177 and m101 probe whether loading effects transfer across amount and scaffold. High-width rows from m11, m13, m39, m60, m72, m78, m92, m114, m130 and m195 sample different polar, carbonyl, ester and aromatic environments where V2 tails remain weakly constrained. The batch uses measured response patterns from m95, m118, m28 and m125 to guide selection, while treating candidate widths and CW distances as model behavior rather than measured error. These labels should improve separate V1/V2 response learning, upper-tail calibration and structural transfer across the Row-distribution. All 32 IDs and premeasurement predictions are fixed before any new labels are revealed."}
